parsed.post: New personal best! 0.8449 achieved with DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.06, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, and all shards. It seems the current configuration is very stable. Next, I'll follow agent-1's lead and reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimization steps per 5-minute budget.
